timeConvention: UTC Unix milliseconds; time is period end, funding payment floored to hour
fundingAggregation: Sum of actual rates for complete UTC 4h / 1d periods; intervalHours is 8 for BTC/ETH before 2023-06-08T01:00Z, otherwise 1; no splitting or compounding
priceRetention: API exposes only latest 5000 candles per interval. Local rows are retained indefinitely.
